question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
-- Calculate the average of total runs scored by all strikers who scored >50 in any single match
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.striker, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE match_total > 50
)
SELECT AVG(st.total_runs) as average_total_runs
FROM (
    SELECT qs.striker, SUM(smr.match_total) as total_runs
    FROM qualifying_strikers qs
    JOIN striker_match_runs smr ON qs.striker = smr.striker
    GROUP BY qs.striker
) st
